# designagent.dev

The site for one plugin: the designagent Figma bridge. Next.js 16 (App
Router) + Tailwind v4. Install commands come from
`.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`; the site lists only plugins named in
`PRESENTATION` in `lib/marketplace.ts` (the bridge). Long-form docs are MDX in
`content/plugins/`.

# Design spec (generated by DesignAgent — source of truth for UI)
@docs/DESIGN.md

Build UI from the spec above: map its tokens onto the Tailwind theme in
`app/globals.css`, reuse the components in `components/`, and honor the Do's and
Don'ts. Light theme, Inter + DM Mono, black as the only brand color, depth via
borders not shadows.
